headline: Winter Hunt
tagline: Bundle up and go spot the snow!

scenes.title: Winter Wilderness Grid
tips: Tick each box as you spot it
scenes.say: Little ones just match the pictures, so even non-readers can lead the snowy walk.

scenes.title: Two-Team Snow Globe
scenes.say: Split siblings into two teams with the same twelve finds and see who finishes first.

scenes.title: Winter Photo Hunt
tips: Jot where you found each one
scenes.say: Hand older kids a phone and let them snap fifteen winter moments, noting where each was.

scenes.title: 4-Senses Journal
scenes.say: Pause on the walk to notice what winter sounds, smells and feels like, not just looks like.

scenes.title: Snow Critter Sketch Hunt
tips: Draw each find in a box
scenes.say: Kids sketch what they spot in the big boxes, turning the walk into a little field guide.

scenes.title: Cozy Indoor Hunt
tips: Snowed in? Hunt room to room
Bonus box for a cozy drawing
scenes.say: Snowed in? Send everyone room to room hunting for warm, cozy comforts instead.

scenes.title: Retro Color Hunt
tips: Find a match for each color
scenes.say: Let the colors lead the search, writing down one winter find for every shade.

tips.title: Before you print
items: Most come in color and B&W
Pop it on a clipboard outside
tips.say: Most pages come in color and black and white, and a clipboard makes them easy to use outside.

say.title: Free printable winter scavenger hunts to get everyone outside this season.
say.hook: Print them, bundle up, and let the snowy hunt begin.
say.end: Download them all free at printamoo dot com.
